\subsection*{1. Dot sizes}
In every style the designer's precomposed letters use one dot, above and below (ȧ ḃ ṅ \ldots, ạ ḅ ọ \ldots ỵ): the same outline as the combining dot above U+0307, the spacing dot accent U+02D9 and the tittle of i and j (semibold's tittle is 120, the rest 124).
